text:
Alex Cheng: FYI — LatticeMetrics submitted an onboarding request for a custom taxonomy model used in claims triage. They specifically requested private deployment (VPC) + PHI-safe handling. Raising here to coordinate safety evals, infra options, and renewal impact.
Maria Rodriguez: Thanks Alex. Do we have their acceptance criteria and timeline?
Alex Cheng: Quick summary from the customer: model is a finetuned 7B, expected steady QPS ~7, peak ~25. Acceptance: NER F1 >= 0.92 on their labeled set, hallucination <1% on PHI extraction, p50 latency <150ms. They want canary + A/B and prefer Dedicated or Private for production. Renewal is in ~6 weeks — they said slow onboarding could impact renewal.
Priya Nair: Ok. We'll need: (1) annotated eval set (preferably 1k+ examples with edge cases), (2) negative prompts set for hallucination tests, (3) model artifacts (tokenizer, config) and whether the model supports 4-bit quant. Also ask for expected sequence lengths (tokens) and typical prompt sizes. Can they provide a presigned S3 link?
Alex Cheng: I'm asking them for the dataset and the artifacts now. They're open to presigned S3. They also want a canary rollout plan and a clear rollback criterion.
Samir Patel: Noted — renewal risk flagged. Can we get a priority slot for this onboarding? If this misses the renewal window, it's high risk.
OnboardBot: Ticket created: ONB-2026-1123 — initial triage assigned to eng-ml. Estimated ETA: safety/eval baseline in 3 business days after datasets arrive.
Maria Rodriguez: Proposed approach: 1) run safety + quality eval on hosted sandbox (with redaction proxy) so we avoid PHI exposure in early runs, 2) if metrics meet thresholds, spin up Dedicated VPC for canary traffic, 3) do A/B with fallback policy and automated quality checks. Action items: request dataset + artifact link, legal check for BAA, schedule 60m enablement + runbook session. I'll book the call once we have dataset.
Alex Cheng: I'll ask for the S3 link and DPA/BAA status. Also pushing the ask for the labeled set with 'ground_truth' column so evals can compute F1.
Priya Nair: For infra recs: if they need <150ms p50, recommend Dedicated with 2x A10/RTX-style GPUs and 4-bit quant where safe; batch size 6-8, KV cache enabled. I'll prep an eval harness and a small prompt set for hallucination/regression tests. Example quick eval command I plan to run:
```
# run eval harness
python eval_harness.py --model-path s3://temp/model --eval-set s3://temp/eval.jsonl --metrics f1,precision,recall,hallucination_rate
```
Alex Cheng: Timeline suggestion: day0 dataset received, day1 safety run (hosted sandbox), day3 canary in Dedicated (low traffic), day7 evaluate and decide go/no-go for full cutover. Is that realistic? :eyes:
Samir Patel: Agree with timeline. I'll coordinate with Sales to make renewal contingent on successful canary by week 2 and notify Finance. I'll also ping Legal for BAA ASAP.
Alex Cheng: Update — customer uploaded sample here: s3://latticemetrics/onboard/samples/2026-03-21 (shared presigned link in DM). I'll post official link when I confirm permissions.
OnboardBot: Eng-ML queue updated, tag: priority-high :rocket:
